Class MapDBHashTable<K,V>

java.lang.Object
jsdp.utilities.hash.MapDBHashTable<K,V>
Type Parameters:
K - the hash table key type
V - the hash table value type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Map<K,V>
public class MapDBHashTable<K,V> extends Object implements Map<K,V>
A wrapper for class HTreeMap from http://www.mapdb.org http://www.mapdb.org/doc/quick-start/ http://www.mapdb.org/doc/htreemap/
